title: Public job create and status with site key
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Public job API
  Scenario: Create job with site key
    Given a valid site key for origin https://example.com
    When the embed POSTs /jobs with hash, text, name, byline and site key
    Then the API stores a pending job and returns status pending
  Scenario: Reject bad origin
    Given a valid site key registered for https://example.com
    When a request arrives with Origin https://evil.example
    Then the API returns 403
```

## Implementation brief
1. Lambda router in cdk/lambdas/router/ for POST /jobs, GET /jobs/{hash}, PUT /jobs/{hash}/done, GET /jobs/claimable.
2. Site-key validator checks key + Origin; rate limits.
3. name/byline stored; defaults from page title/site name if absent.
4. GET returns signed audio URL when done (not public).
5. Acceptance: feature tests with mocked DynamoDB/S3.
